title: Slitherilla - Run It Up
htmlContent:
Slitherilla releases a wonderful single called "Run It Up," an incredible record that has that sound, that you know you will be hearing it come out of speakers all over. Everything clicks from the engaging hard production, dope lyrics, and the flow that floats over this production to perfection.
